picks.analysis: With Jahmyr Gibbs securing his contract extension, the Lions have been focusing on integrating him into their offensive schemes. However, the Bengals' defensive line rotation, particularly with their depth at edge rusher, has been disruptive in camp. Cincinnati's secondary has also shown strong chemistry, limiting big plays during scrimmages. This defensive cohesion gives the Bengals an edge in controlling the Lions' offensive tempo.

The Commanders' defense, led by standout performances from their new acquisitions, has been a highlight in training camp. Miami's offensive line has struggled with consistency, particularly against interior pass rushers, which could be a significant issue against Washington's aggressive front. Additionally, the Commanders' secondary has been making strides, with Rasul Douglas expected to contribute early, potentially limiting Miami's deep passing game.

The Broncos have been impressive in camp, with their defensive unit, particularly the linebackers, showing excellent sideline-to-sideline speed. Atlanta's offensive line has had issues with pass protection, which could be exploited by Denver's blitz-heavy scheme. Additionally, the Broncos' depth at wide receiver has been a standout, with Marvin Mims Jr. emerging as a reliable target, adding another layer to their offensive attack.

Seattle's defensive front, bolstered by DeMarcus Lawrence's leadership, has been dominant in camp, creating pressure consistently. Dallas' offensive line, while talented, has shown vulnerabilities against speed rushers, which Seattle is well-equipped to exploit. Moreover, the Seahawks' secondary has been cohesive, limiting explosive plays, which could stifle Dallas' passing game.

picks.matchup: Indianapolis Colts vs New England Patriots
picks.analysis: With Cam Taylor-Britt suspended, the Colts' secondary depth will be tested against a Patriots receiving corps that has been dynamic in camp. New England's offense, led by Drake Maye, has shown versatility, effectively utilizing their tight end sets to create mismatches. The Patriots' defense has also been stout against the run, which could limit Indianapolis' ability to control the game on the ground.
